tools.name: search_regions
tools.description:
Find region codes by name (English, Korean or Chinese), e.g. "Gangnam", "Suwon", "해운대".
        level: 1 = si/do (province/metro city), 2 = si/gun/gu (district), 3 = eup/myeon/dong.
        Each result has `region_code`, the value to pass as `region` to the other tools.

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description:
List reported lease transactions in a region, newest first.

tools.description:
Nationwide data freshness per source: latest collected deal month, last refresh time and row count
